To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
T cells can recognize and interact with B lymphocytes and that the H-2 gene product(s) is the B-cell acceptor for the T-cell recognition system.

(1) T-B lymphocyte interactions are controlled in part by the H-2 gene region; (2) H-2 compatibility between T and B lymphocyte clones is necessary for the expression of the immune response; and (3) H-2 incompatibility between T and B clones results in the suppression of the immune response.
the H-2 gene or genes control the capacity of T and B lymphocyte to interact in an effective fashion and that the H- 2 gene complex controls the expression of a T-cell receptor.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the elucidation of the genetic control of T and B lymphocyte cooperative responses.
the elucidation of the mechanisms involved in cell interactions between histoincompatabile T and B lymphocyte.
the mechanisms of lymphocyte interactions and the nature of the molecules involved.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the H-2 gene or genes are necessary for the successful cooperation of histoincompatible T-B lymphocytes.
the H-2 gene or genes are responsible for the expression of an acceptor molecule or molecule(s) on the B-cell membrane.
T and B cells must interact to produce a cooperative response.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the H-2 gene region codes for the "acceptor" site for the active T lymphocyte product or for the active T cell.
T and B cells must interact with each other in an H-2-restricted manner in order to cooperate effectively in the production of antibody.
the H-2 gene product is a T-cell receptor for B-lymphocytes.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the H-2 gene products play a major role in the physiologic regulation of T and B lymphocyte interactions.
the H-2 gene region is involved in the regulation of immune responsiveness.
the H-2 gene product(s) on the B- and T-lymphocyte surfaces are involved in cell interactions.
